Update4 November 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜Patch Notes - November 5, 2026
This update brings fixes to Primal Anthalon, improvements to Classic+ with new customizable settings, better skill queuing, enhanced autocomplete, improved sound, and a variety of bug fixes across the game.

Global Changes

Primal Anthalon

  • Eternal Spires will no longer respawn after 10 minutes.
  • Generals will no longer immediately die when they are reset.
  • Fixed several issues where killing the dread sentries would sometimes not correctly advance the ritual.
  • Decay now lasts 30 seconds (no longer infinite duration). Applying new stacks of Decay will reset this timer.

Bug Fixes

  • Fix: The new Green Quests are now in the quest log properly
  • Fix: Mist Missile Rain should trigger more consistently while using Hollow Deadeye

Classic+ Client Update

Feature Changes

  • You can now turn with strafe on steamtank cannons and gliding mounts like the Typhoon Drake
  • The unread mail tooltip now shows you up to 5 recent senders of unread mail in your inbox
  • Many new customizations have been added to the Archeage Classic Options (Settings) Menu
    • Screen Options > Graphics Settings > Enable underwater shimmer effect (off)
    • Misc. Settings > Auction House Settings > Autocomplete Auction House searches (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Chat Settings > Autocomplete player names for invites (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Chat Settings > Autocomplete player names for whispers (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Chat Settings > Autocomplete emojis (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Mail Settings > Autocomplete recipient player names (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Mail Settings > Preview recent senders in unread mail tooltip (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Control Settings > Enable improved skill queue (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Control Settings > Snap crops to land borders and other objects (on)
    • Misc. Settings > Control Settings > Allow strafe keys to also turn vehicles and gliders (on)
    • Misc. Settings > HUD Settings > Darken minimap background when holding SHIFT (off)
    • Misc. Settings > HUD Settings > Click through chat background and text (off)

Bug Fixes

  • Auction House search autocomplete can now be skipped by pressing ENTER
  • Mail "To:" autocomplete can now be skipped by pressing ENTER
  • Sound has had further work done to reduce "loud pops" and other issues. Thanks to Kami for reports to work from!
  • The improved skill queue has had the way it handles Triple Slash (Basic, Lightning, Quake) adjusted to perform better
  • The "Device Removed" error now gives you more detailed information about the source of the removed device whether it is driver, hardware, or operating system related
  • During the Dochul fight in Mistsong Summit, the warning lasers show properly before the deadly lasers fire
  • Minimap alignment on the "Small" and "Medium" settings has become more accurate. Please report any issues with remaining zones
  • Various performance improvements

== Global Changes ==

== Primal Anthalon ==
* Eternal Spires will no longer respawn after 10 minutes.
* Generals will no longer immediately die when they are reset.
* Fixed several issues where killing the dread sentries would sometimes not correctly advance the ritual.
* Decay now lasts 30 seconds (no longer infinite duration). Applying new stacks of Decay will reset this timer.

== Bug Fixes ==
* Fix: The new Green Quests are now in the quest log properly
* Fix: Mist Missile Rain should trigger more consistently while using Hollow Deadeye

== Classic+ Client Update ==

== Feature Changes ==
* You can now turn with strafe on steamtank cannons and gliding mounts like the Typhoon Drake
* The unread mail tooltip now shows you up to 5 recent senders of unread mail in your inbox
* Many new customizations have been added to the Archeage Classic Options (Settings) Menu
** Screen Options > Graphics Settings > Enable underwater shimmer effect (off)
** Misc. Settings > Auction House Settings > Autocomplete Auction House searches (on)
** Misc. Settings > Chat Settings > Autocomplete player names for invites (on)
** Misc. Settings > Chat Settings > Autocomplete player names for whispers (on)
** Misc. Settings > Chat Settings > Autocomplete emojis (on)
** Misc. Settings > Mail Settings > Autocomplete recipient player names (on)
** Misc. Settings > Mail Settings > Preview recent senders in unread mail tooltip (on)
** Misc. Settings > Control Settings > Enable improved skill queue (on)
** Misc. Settings > Control Settings > Snap crops to land borders and other objects (on)
** Misc. Settings > Control Settings > Allow strafe keys to also turn vehicles and gliders (on)
** Misc. Settings > HUD Settings > Darken minimap background when holding SHIFT (off)
** Misc. Settings > HUD Settings > Click through chat background and text (off)

== Bug Fixes ==
* Auction House search autocomplete can now be skipped by pressing ENTER
* Mail "To:" autocomplete can now be skipped by pressing ENTER
* Sound has had further work done to reduce "loud pops" and other issues. Thanks to Kami for reports to work from!
* The improved skill queue has had the way it handles Triple Slash (Basic, Lightning, Quake) adjusted to perform better
* The "Device Removed" error now gives you more detailed information about the source of the removed device whether it is driver, hardware, or operating system related
* During the Dochul fight in Mistsong Summit, the warning lasers show properly before the deadly lasers fire
* Minimap alignment on the "Small" and "Medium" settings has become more accurate. Please report any issues with remaining zones
* Various performance improvements
